title: Chapter 20 Generous Rewards
content:
Chapter 20 Generous Rewards

A few minutes later, the crocodile stopped moving. Wang Shuo looked closely and found that its health bar had not been cleared.

"Oh, it still knows how to play dead." Wang Shuo couldn't help laughing.

In order to prevent the crocodile from counterattacking before death, Wang Shuo approached the crocodile as carefully as possible, and then pulled out his spear.

Suddenly, a stream of blood mixed with brain matter gushed out. The crocodile stopped pretending and struggled desperately.

Take advantage of your illness to kill you!

Wang Shuo stabbed the crocodile's eyes with his spear again, the same one as before, but this time he stabbed deeper.

[You used the spear to deal a fatal blow to the crocodile, causing 200 points of damage. ]

Wang Shuo was relieved now. The crocodile was just struggling to death for the rest of the time.

Another 5 minutes, and the crocodile's health value was cleared.

[You killed the elite crocodile (ID: Crocodile 21037 Chag), and were rewarded with +1 for all attributes. Since you are the first player to kill an elite monster, you are rewarded with "Mercenary Contract" × 1, wheat seeds × 10]

[Your level is increased to level 3, and you get 1 distributable attribute point. 】

After receiving the system notification that the crocodile was dead, Wang Shuo was relieved and sat on the ground, gasping for breath.

At this time, he noticed that the crocodile actually had an ID number and a name.

He was shocked. What kind of world is this? Aren't these monsters generated by the system?

For a moment, he fell into deep thought.

Is it only by killing wild monsters that you can get its ID information?

As long as you attack the monster, you can get the level and health information?

There is only one monster, and Wang Shuo is a little unsure whether his guess is accurate.

It seems that he can only supplement the information about the monster later.

After resting for a long time, he got up and walked towards the crocodile.

[Found the crocodile corpse, do you want to decompose it? ]

"Yes."

[Advanced crocodile leather × 12, meat × 100, bones × 40]

[Found bronze treasure chest × 3, "leather armor production drawings" × 1, "leather boots production drawings" × 1, energy crystals × 12, soul crystals × 1, do you want to pick them up? ]

What else do you want?

Wang Shuo said without a second thought: "Yes."

Killing monsters can also explode energy crystals and soul crystals, which made Wang Shuo think.

But he didn't think much about it. After a life-and-death experience, he finally got a rich reward. Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction.

After cleaning the battlefield, he recovered 1,600 bricks, and the rest were damaged by crocodiles. Wang Shuo got up and returned to the shelter.

After a simple rinse with hot water, the blood and sweat stains on his body, and adding some firewood under the kang, Wang Shuo lay on the bed and fell asleep soon.

Just as Wang Shuo was sleeping, another crocodile in the swamp territory seemed to have discovered the death of the elite crocodile, and suddenly became a little restless.

Soon after, it seemed to have made a decision, left the crocodile egg it was guarding, and went to the east of the swamp.

The next morning, the weather became much colder, but for Wang Shuo, who had a cotton coat, it was not a big problem.

At dawn, Wang Shuo came to the swamp in the south without stopping. The temptation of the treasure chest was undoubtedly huge.

After stepping on the bamboo raft, Wang Shuo got the bronze treasure chest soon, but at this moment, Wang Shuo found that there were many animal footprints of different sizes in the deep swamp.

Wang Shuo knew that the largest one was the footprint of the elite crocodile he killed.

It seemed that there was more than one crocodile. Wang Shuo secretly called it luck that he did not encounter other crocodiles, so he quickly retreated.

After returning to the territory, Wang Shuo instantly felt that he had no worries about food and clothing. If he did not care about the beasts in the swamp, this would be a rare comfortable day.

With the replenishment of supplies, Wang Shuo stewed the rice, and also fried a tomato scrambled egg with 2 eggs and tomatoes, and had a full meal.

While eating, Wang Shuo browsed the information in the "Survivor's Handbook".

(Day 5, 8:38 am, the number of survivors in the current area: 4231/10000.)

The number of people is still decreasing, but the decline is not as large as before.

Players who have survived until now have basically mastered some survival skills.

[Main Quest]: Survive to the end.

[Side Quest]

1. Please upgrade the residential house to a residential house as soon as possible.

(Upgrade conditions: 500 wood + 2000 bricks + 1000 tiles + 400 stones + 1 energy crystal.)

Wang Shuo then discovered that after he killed the elite crocodile, he seemed to have obtained 1 soul crystal and 12 energy crystals.

Now he finally knows the purpose of the energy crystal.

He looked at his backpack again and found that the materials for upgrading the residential house should be gathered within today. He couldn't help but feel better.

2. Collect more materials, build more buildings, make more tools, upgrade higher-level shelters, ... to get a higher ranking.

Wang Shuo remembered what Lord Zach said, that the elimination round would start on the morning of the 14th day.

Wang Shuo was a little nervous for a moment, although he felt that it should not be a big problem for him to survive to the elimination round.

But he was not sure whether he would be eliminated in the elimination round.

Thinking of the fact that there are always some European players who were born in places with abundant resources, he suddenly felt a lot of pressure. After all, his territory is a swamp, a place where resources are not abundant.

No, I still don’t have the qualifications to lie down, I have to keep working hard.

After breakfast, Wang Shuo immediately started making bricks and other materials.

While making bricks and tiles, Wang Shuo thought that there was another chef named Zhang, and he needed to provide plates and bowls, so he also made them.

When checking the backpack and warehouse, Wang Shuo found that there were still 4 treasure chests.

He grinned, rubbed his hands, took out the treasure chest and key, and was about to open the treasure chest.

He suddenly stopped, slapped his forehead suddenly, and screamed: "I almost forgot that I haven't washed my hands yet."

So he hurried to wash his hands, and silently said in his heart again: "Buddha bless! Good things must be opened."

The first treasure chest was opened, and the golden color made his eyes shine.

[Gold Coins × 50]

Although there were no blueprints, weapons, etc., Wang Shuo was still very happy with 50 gold coins.

The second treasure chest opened: coal × 500, iron ore × 500, bronze ore × 300

It turned out to be a resource treasure chest. Wang Shuo guessed, "Could it be that the coal and iron that the previous players exchanged with me also came from this?"

The other two treasure chests opened 2 primary construction acceleration scrolls, 10 gold coins, and 10 units of cucumber, potato, and rice seeds.

After all, it was a bronze treasure chest, and it was not surprising that Wang Shuo could open these things.

Next, he planned to go to the back of the house to build farmland and breeding farms.

Walking behind the house, Wang Shuo took out the "farmland construction drawings" and silently recited in his mind.

15 3×5 grid phantoms appeared in front of him, each of which was 1 square meter in size.

Wang Shuo dropped the phantom on the ground, and immediately, fields like tofu appeared on the ground.

The system prompts that it will take ten minutes to build farmland.

Wang Shuo also built a 50-square-meter breeding farm not far away.

At present, he does not have any animals that can be raised, so he can only wait until later.

But he can use the farmland.

He took out the seeds he had obtained. Each piece of farmland could be planted with one unit of seeds, which was quite convenient.

So he planted 5 units of wheat, 2 units of cucumbers, and 3 units of potatoes.

After planting, he found that the growth cycle of the crops was only 48 hours.

This was really a game.

Then he ignored it and looked at the time. It was almost noon. He found that the plates and bowls were almost finished, so he contacted Chef Zhang.
